process_lessons.lesson: Cross-workload negative evidence can falsify a mechanism as a complete release fix before an expensive full rerun, while still preserving it as a partial product seed.
Do not reinterpret component evidence into release authority; use it to choose the next causal owner.
Memory diagnostics must record pre-operation high-water before assigning incremental ownership.
A configured trigger is not a receipt.
